My overall teaching activities have been solely related with the 61^st^
<abbr lang="fr" title='Conseil National des Universités'>CNU</abbr>[^1] section which regroups scientific disciplines from control,
computer engineering and signal processing. I taught these teaching,
first, as a temporary teacher (3 years, 2003-2006), teaching assistant
(ATER, 1 year, 2007), and then as associate professor (10 years).

[^1]: The National Council of Universities, that is from French
    "[Conseil national des universités]{.fr lang="fr"}" (CNU),
    comprises 57 sections covering different scientific disciplines.
    <http://www.cpcnu.fr>

Since 2008, as member of the teaching team on the campus in Bourges of
the INSA [Centre Val de Loire]{.fr lang="fr"}, I am mainly involved in
the students formation of the Industrial Risk Control[^2] (<abbr lang="fr" title="Maîtrise des Risques Industriels">MRI</abbr>), of the
Energy, Risk and the Environment[^3] (<abbr lang="en" title="Energy, Risks and Environment">ERE</abbr>), and of the Sciences and
Techniques for Engineers[^4] (<abbr lang="fr" title="Science et Technique pour l'Ingénieur">STPI</abbr>) departments. Specifically, after
having started with teaching of electronics and electrical engineering,
I have participated or organized lessons on signal processing, sensors,
control and robotics. These various teaching experiences imply very
different pedagogical tasks. Especially, those tasks are depending on
the type of intervention: courses (C), tutorials (TD), practical works
(TP), tutored projects (P), long-term project team work (BE); but also
according to the different degrees of scientific maturity and
specialization of the concerned students, from bachelor's to master's
degrees level. In particular, I am especially involved in the
implementation of the teachings materials, and to support the teaching
assistants for the disciplines for which I am in charge.

[^2]: From French "[Maîtrise des Risques Industriels]{.fr
    lang="fr"}" (MRI). The MRI speciality is defined by a systemic risk
    approach (cindynics, or risk analysis).
    <http://www.insa-centrevaldeloire.fr/en/training/industrial-risk-control>

[^3]: Energy, Risk and the Environment (ERE) is a joint formation with
    Cher Chamber of Commerce and Industry (CCI) Hubert Curien CFSA
    (Apprentice Further Training Centre) in Bourges. The ERE department
    trains engineers through apprenticeship training.
    <http://www.insa-centrevaldeloire.fr/en/training/energy-risks-and%E2%88%92the-environment>

[^4]: From French "[Science et Technique pour l'Ingénieur]{.fr
    lang="fr"}" (STPI). The STPI department teaches a core syllabus for
    the first two years so as to equip future engineering students with
    the necessary fundamentals for continuing their studies.
    <http://www.insa-centrevaldeloire.fr/en/training/engineering-science-and-technology>
